sections.heading: Start a blog you own, with the audience to match.
body: Start a blog with posts, categories, SEO fields, sitemaps and structured data, served fast on your own domain, with email campaigns to the readers you collect. Describe it and Aglyn AI drafts the layout. Free to start.

sections.heading: Most blogs live on someone else’s platform, with their branding and their rules. Aglyn puts your blog on your own site and domain — designed your way, open source underneath.

sections.heading: Questions about starting a blog.
body: Publishing, ranking, subscribers and ownership, in plain terms.

items.title: How do I start a blog for free?
items.body: Sign up, add the blog to your site, write your first post and publish on an aglyn.app address. Your own domain starts at Starter.

items.title: Can I schedule posts?
items.body: Yes. Write now and set a publish time.

items.title: Will my blog rank on Google?
items.body: It has the parts that rank: SEO fields on every post, sitemaps, structured data and fast CDN delivery. Ranking still depends on what you write.

items.title: Can readers subscribe by email?
items.body: Yes. A sign-up form collects subscribers with consent, and campaigns go out from Marketing on Pro and up.

items.title: Does my blog have an RSS feed?
items.body: Yes. Every blog publishes an RSS feed, and readers can also subscribe by email.

items.title: Can I add a store or memberships later?
items.body: Yes. Commerce and memberships run on the same site when you are ready.

items.title: Do I own my content?
items.body: Yes. Your posts, media and subscriber list live in your organization on an open-source platform you could self-host.

items.title: What is Aglyn?
items.body: Aglyn is a website builder with the store, forms, CRM, email, analytics and Aglyn AI built in. It is open source and free to start.
